subject: Year-end capacity adjustment & settlement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Erin Shaw <erin@cloudsync.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Year-end capacity adjustment & settlement

Hi Erin —

Hope you had a smooth holiday weekend. Quick note on CloudSync's Q4 usage: our systems show total consumption for November exceeded your committed baseline (Dedicated 2K tokens/hour) by ~48% driven by a short burst during your year-end batch jobs. We ran the reconciliations attached (usage-summary-q4-2026.csv) and put together a proposed one-time settlement and amendment (proposed-amendment.pdf) reflecting: 

- Retrospective overage: 1,240,000 tokens charged at agreed overage rate = $14,880
- One-time invoice to settle Q4 true-up, due net 30
- Optional six-month top-up: bump to Dedicated 3K tokens/hour with a 5% overage credit on this settlement if agreed by 2026-12-10

Would you be able to review the numbers and confirm whether we should: (A) issue the one-time invoice now, or (B) roll the charge into an amendment and DocuSign for the top-up? If you prefer a short call, I can book 15 minutes this week.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Lead, Growth 
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: usage-summary-q4-2026.csv, proposed-amendment.pdf

From: Erin Shaw <erin@cloudsync.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Year-end capacity adjustment & settlement

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick breakdown and for flagging. I'm pulling our internal usage export and will compare, attaching our CSV (cloudsync-usage-export.csv). A couple quick Qs: 

1) Can you provide the hour-by-hour spike window so we can cross-check with our batch jobs?
2) For the 5% credit on the settlement: does that apply to the numeric overage amount only (i.e., $14,880 * 0.95) or to the combined settlement + first month of the top-up?

Proposed next step: I can get procurement involved if we are moving to a signed amendment. If you could send a clear mutual action plan and a DocuSign link with the amended term, that'll help speed things. 

—Erin
Erin Shaw
Head of Platform Operations
CloudSync, Inc.
erin@cloudsync.com | +1 (206) 555-0133

Attachment: cloudsync-usage-export.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Erin Shaw <erin@cloudsync.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Year-end capacity adjustment & settlement

Erin —

Appreciate the quick turn. Hour-by-hour window is 2026-11-22 01:00–06:00 PST (UTC-8) — we see sustained request rate increases beginning 01:12 and peaking 03:40. I've attached the hourly export as a tab in usage-summary-q4-2026.csv.

Credit terms: the 5% credit would apply to the one-time overage settlement only (so $14,880 * 0.95 = $14,136). If you opt to sign the six-month top-up today, we'll provide that credit on this settlement and also lock in the top-up pricing shown in the proposed amendment.

Mutual action plan (short):
- Today: confirm approach A (invoice now) or B (amendment + DocuSign)
- By 2026-12-10: sign amendment (if B) to receive 5% credit
- 2026-12-15: invoice issued (either standalone or as first amended invoice)

If that looks good I'll have Legal generate the DocuSign and Tracy in Billing will prepare the settlement invoice PDF.

Best,
Marissa

Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Year-end capacity adjustment & settlement

Erin / Marissa —

Quick note from pricing: to make the settlement smoother for CloudSync, we can offer an additional concession: if CloudSync signs the six-month top-up amendment by 2026-12-10, Redwood will apply a one-time promotional credit equal to 5% of the overage AND waive the amendment setup fee (normally $1,200). The credit will be applied to the settlement invoice.

Marissa — please add the waiver to the proposed-amendment.pdf and confirm invoice workflow (standalone vs. bundled).

Vivek
VP, Commercials
Redwood Inference

Thanks — all sounds reasonable. We accept option B: please send the amendment via DocuSign and include the 5% credit + setup-fee waiver. I've looped in procurement (Marcus Willis) for the signature and PO.

Marcus — Marcus, this is our vendor Redwood Inference. Marissa will send the amended SOW and DocuSign link. Please advise if you need a PO number, and we'll route it.

Marissa, can you confirm whether the settlement invoice will be sent as a separate PDF or appended to the first month of the top-up billing? We prefer separate so bookkeeping can treat the settlement as a one-time adjustment.

—Erin
